The Judy Jam

Newburyport, MA · Road

No-drop

The Judy Jam is a road group ride in Newburyport, MA. It rolls every Monday at 5:30 pm from Riverside Cycle, Newburyport. About 16–24 miles, 14+ mph, A and B groups. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: 14+ mph, A and B groups. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Judy Jam group ride

Riverside's Monday night no-drop ride with a sweeper, led by Judy. Two groups, sixteen to twenty-four miles on the North Shore. The shop also runs a faster Tuesday ride, a Wednesday gravel ride and a Thursday MTB ride out of Manchester-by-the-Sea. Details come by weekly email.
